added.name: Notification_Trove_Gifting
added.value:
Trove of Terror Gifting Update

Functionality that was intended to prevent exploitation of gift exchanges was instead mistakenly applied to all items coming out of the Trove of Terror, preventing any gifting from taking place.

The vast majority of gifting between friends takes place right after opening a treasure. To support friend gifting while we continue to iterate on the anti-exploit code, we've re-enabled gifting for all Trove of Terror sets: Each set can be gifted to a friend once within thirty days. For sets already in your inventory, the thirty days start now. For newly opened Troves, they start when the Trove is opened.

As some sets that would have been gifted if possible were instead recycled, we've granted everyone one new Trove of Terror per six recycling credits so far, rounded up.
